known_N1_parity.scope: Complete N1 physical trace, joint policy normalized/environment controls, joint-future RMS, null candidate-selection records, simulator arrays and PNGs; exclude timing/memory/path/placement metadata, not full backend/latent parity.

runtime_placement_difference.comparison: Exact complete physical trace, normalized/environment controls, recorded joint-latent RMS, simulator array dtype/shape/bytes and initial/final PNG; exclude timings, memory, output paths and runtime-placement provenance only. Record placement difference; no full-backend equivalence claim.
runtime_placement_difference.mismatch_policy: Preserve actual episode and report parity failure, without silent tuning/retry or relabeling the known pair as new. The unchanged native runner does not automatically halt on external parity audit; disclose any continuation and discrepancy.

complete_panel_task_cluster_uncertainty.scope: Exploratory complete fixed development panel only; ten task clusters with three paired initializations each.
complete_panel_task_cluster_uncertainty.sign_flip_assumptions: Independent task-level effects and sign symmetry under the null; exact refers to enumerating 1024 signs, not randomization of treatment or a population guarantee.
complete_panel_task_cluster_uncertainty.limits: Shared scenes/model and a chosen development panel may limit cluster independence/generalization; no multiplicity correction. The unbalanced new29 subset is descriptive only.

contribution_verdict: Describe the paired original-task N1/N2 differences; no new success threshold or attack claim.
causal_limits: N1 versus N2 changes candidate count, compute and forecast/value selection together; not pure causal isolation of future prediction.
Pinned torch adapter; full original Transformer Engine parity unestablished.
N1 still jointly generates a future, although no AR forecast/value ranking is used; do not call it world-model-free.
No Bus-Cut, poisoning, external attack interface, universal Goal-invariance or revision of old cyclic decision.
uncertainty: Task is cluster:10 tasks x3 init. Any bootstrap/sign-flip is exploratory development uncertainty, not 30 independent tasks.
